title: Choose the portal's world: the familiar hand
question: You asked for safer. Three familiar directions and the category standard. Pick one, or re-roll.

options.label: Native Mac
options.lineage: macOS Mail, Reminders and the Finder source list
options.thesis: Dogsled as a well-behaved Mac app: a source list that starts with what waits on you.
options.viewport: Sidebar with the Waiting on you section pinned above the agents tree; conversation centre; todo inspector right; host load in the toolbar.
options.risk: Looks like a stock Mac app, and a light window sits beside a dark Herdr terminal.

options.label: Pull Request
options.lineage: GitHub Primer: notifications, PR timelines, task lists
options.thesis: Every lead reads like a pull request you are reviewing: a timeline, state labels and a task list.
options.viewport: Notifications column, repositories column, the lead's timeline with the composer below, and a PR-style sidebar with the task list.
options.risk: Comment boxes cost more height than chat, and four columns make the conversation narrow.

options.label: Workspace Chat
options.lineage: Slack: aubergine sidebar, unread weight, mention badges
options.thesis: Leads are channels you talk in; a red badge means an agent needs you.
options.viewport: Aubergine sidebar of repositories and leads with badges; messages centre; right pane with Waiting on you above the todos.
options.risk: The agent reads as a coworker in a chat app; the inbox sits on the right, not the left.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The dark agent console of Linear, Cursor and Conductor, at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Inbox strip under the top bar; agents left; conversation centre; todos right.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other agent console by design.
